title: Macro Claim-Ordering Strategies Across Arrival Regimes

arrival_generation.population_design: Claimant population generated independently of arrival ordering (N_mule and N_honest equal, 50,000 paise each)
arrival_generation.arrival_property: Neutral, deterministic original arrival sequence where mule and honest claims are interspersed independently of claimant category

ordering_strategies.GENUINE_FIFO: Preserves neutral deterministic original arrival sequence without reordering or sorting by category
ordering_strategies.INTERLEAVED_FIFO: Synthetic interleaved submission order alternating mule and honest claims
ordering_strategies.RANDOM: Stochastic permutation seeded by 70000 + N*1000 + seed
ordering_strategies.MULE_FIRST: Adversary front-running sensitivity bound (all mule claims arrive before honest claims)
ordering_strategies.HONEST_FIRST: Protective clearinghouse ingestion bound (all honest claims arrive before mule claims)

statistical_methodology.within_regime_variability: Computed across seeds for each strategy; zero variability for deterministic strategies is explicitly marked as fixed sequence artifact
statistical_methodology.across_regime_sensitivity: OS_across = max(mean metric across 5 regimes) - min(mean metric across 5 regimes)
